message.content: **The Statue of Liberty** (1886) is often regarded as the most iconic sculpture of the 19th century. Designed by Frédéric Auguste Bourgeois and completed by the French sculptor and engineer Alexandre Boulé, it was gifted to the United States by France and has become a global symbol of freedom and democracy. Its monumental size, dramatic pose, and the fact that it was erected in a major world‑event era (the centennial of the American Revolution) have cemented its place as the most famous 19th‑century sculpture in popular culture.
